description: CAMERA IN HER HANDS — a delightful role-reversal portrait: a young Vietnamese woman with short curled hair, in a pale embroidered blouse and dark skirt, stands laughing INSIDE the camp wire holding a small BLUE-GREY CAMERA with its strap looped on her wrist — apparently about to take (or having just taken) a picture herself. Behind her: the sandbagged emplacement ring, double barbed-wire fence, the NEW PREFAB BUILDINGS under construction (the VN-0104 site — men working on a roof at upper left), concrete slabs, the village's tin roofs, palms, and the mountain rim beyond.
setting: The coastal camp construction period (Nha Trang chain) — one of the camp's Vietnamese staff or a soldier's friend, trusted with the camera. If she took a frame, it may be IN this collection — a lovely research wrinkle.

people.notes: The woman + a distant roof worker. Larry may remember her name.
